mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 5-year moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS (both rising in the last month) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained environment (INDPRO below 105), inflationary pressures and reduced corporate margins lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 5-year moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE below 4.0%), strong wage growth and consumer spending drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1 (both falling in the last quarter) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
